title: Live Metro Rail Tracking System
description: Real-time tracking framework using GPS and 4G GSM with a mobile app utilizing Dijkstra's algorithm for quickest-route identification.

title: FarmSurveil — IoT x AI Precision Farming Tool
description: Low-cost IoT & AI precision farming system using ESP32 with multi-sensors collecting 50,000+ real-time data points. LSTM and deep learning models for crop recommendation and yield prediction.

title: Public Transport Network Optimization
description: Digital twin-based framework for optimising urban public transport using TfL BUSTO dataset, DBSCAN clustering, isochrone analysis, and metaheuristic algorithms with SUMO simulation.
